entries.en: [Grunt] You humans think you're so superior.
But you're no better than us. I gave you a chance to save them and you threw it away [cough]. Who's the real terrorist here?
[laughs] You'll have to do better than that if you want to stop us.
You humans.
You're almost more trouble than you're worth.
Predictable. But this is over.
I don't answer to the Council! Or to you.
I'm leaving this asteroid. If you try to stop me, I'll detonate these charges and your helper and her friends are all going to die.
You and I are nothing alike. You killed those people. You pushed the button. And now you'll pay for it.
I'm just getting started.
Let the hostages go and maybe you'll live long enough to explain yourself to the Council.
You're delirious.
[Fire Warning Shot]
A lot more.
What are you doing?
Maybe. But I made sure you won't follow me today. Those charges are still on a timer.
I hope this is worth it!
I'm going to enjoy gutting you.
Go ahead, kill me. I'm not afraid to die. But know this...
[coughs] One day soon, the human race is going to pay for what it's done.
It is a crusade [coughs]... and we won't stop until we wipe your filth from the universe.
No! Not this time. We've learned from our mistakes. We'll be ready.
[grunting] Damn it. [grunting] You think killing me will make a difference?
There are thousands more like me, waiting their turn. Each one willing to die for our cause.
Believe what you want.
When the vids flash with images of your colonies in flames, you'll know the batarian rebellion has begun [coughing].
[screams] What? What do you want? Details? It doesn't matter... [gasp].... It's too late for you.
[spits] I'm through talking.
[coughs] Just kill me. Get it over with.
You can go. But this isn't over. I'll find you eventually.
I'm not letting a terrorist like you go free. Do what you want with the others, but it'll be the last thing you do!
You're just a demented madman who gets off on killing humans. Don't try to make it sound like some holy crusade.
Do you really think the result would be any different this time? An attack against us would be suicide.
Then die already...
And they chose you for this mission? Then I guess we have nothing to worry about.
Who's your leader? Who's orchestrating all this?
Gladly.
Killing you is too much of a mercy. You can die... slowly.
You're not going to die. We'll drop you off on Terra Nova and let Alliance officials deal with you. I doubt they'll be too friendly.
Not likely.
You never learn.
[Graze him]
[Kill him]
Thousands?
[Wound Him]
A rebellion?
[Kill him]
[Leave him to die]
[Leave him for the Alliance]
[Let him go to save hostages]
[Attack him]
This isn't over... [coughs]. This is just the beginning for the batarian nation.
Really? You invaded our space. Took our resources. And when we asked the Council for aid, they brushed us off.
Didn't do anything? Aside from colonizing a world that could have been ours? Aside from using resources that should have been ours?
It was you. You and your kind are the only reason we're in this position.
Enough!
You couldn't possibly understand.... Actually, you just don't want to understand. And I'm done wasting my breath.
Now, if you want your friends to live, I suggest you step aside.
That's why we attacked you at Elysium. That's why I'm doing this. You forced our hand!
What I've done? This is nothing compared to what's been done to the batarians.
This is nothing. You humans have done far worse to the batarians.
We've been forced into exile. Forced to survive on what we can scrounge up. It's been like that for decades.
You don't get to leave, Balak. Not after what you've done.
I can't just let you go, Balak. Not after what happened here.
Don't make it sound like you're the innocent party here. You brought it upon yourselves.
Why take it out on these people? They didn't do anything to you or the batarians.
Is that what Elysium was? A way to get our attention? Well, you got it. And when we responded you ran like cowards. Now you want to start it all over again.
You attacked us first. When we retaliated, you ran off to the Council hoping for help. When you didn't get it, you hid. You've got no one to blame but yourselves.
Over my dead body.
It's not that easy.
It's your own damn fault.
Why blame us?
Like Elysium?
Interesting viewpoint.
That's not true.
Really?
We were left to defend ourselves. But the humans were stronger than us. We knew that. The Council knew that. But it didn't matter.
I could ask you the same thing. How many innocent batarians died at Torfan?
Or had you forgotten about that?
We had no other options. Sometimes you need to get someone's attention before they'll listen.
The batarians have stayed hidden long enough. We won't be ignored. Not anymore.
We didn't pull away; we were forced out. And don't try to hide behind the Council.
You. But you're dead.
You pulled away from the Council. What did you think would happen?
How does killing innocent people make up for that?
Torfan was retaliation for your attack on Elysium. You pushed, we pushed back.
[Kill him]
Obviously.
That doesn't make it right.
What's your point?
Have *you* forgotten?
That was different.
Bloody terrorists!
Better hurry if you want to save your friends.
I can't believe you let Balak go... to save us.
Thank you. For everything.
It's not your fault. You did what you could. At least Aaron died in a place he loved.
Yes. Aaron.
He was the one who convinced me to join the team here. Said it would be an adventure.
I half expected you to just let us die. Sacrifice the few for the many.
Huh. You sound like my brother. He was always so stubborn. But always willing to do the right thing... no matter what.
I-- I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but I should see to Aaron.
Thank you-- huh, I don't even know your name.
Thank you, Commander Shepard. You're not exactly what I expected, but thank you.
The asteroid was scheduled to arrive in a day or two. Balak just sped it up.
This rock is full of valuable minerals, but it was too far from Terra Nova to be profitable. So we attached some fusion rockets to it and drove it back.
It was all going smoothly until...
We'll get everything back to normal soon enough... almost everything.
I don't even think they knew. When they first arrived, they were talking about getting us back to their ship. They wanted to sell us as slaves.
When Balak showed up, everything changed. It was his idea to redirect the asteroid. Said it was the will of the batarian rebellion. Whatever that is.
They followed him quickly enough, but--I don't know--I don't think they're all as fanatical as he was.
"Stubborn and determined" runs in the family. My father was in the Alliance, back on Earth.
I think he was disappointed none of his kids signed up, but he'd be proud of Aaron.
Sorry... I'm just...
Thank you again, Commander. You've done more than you know.
There are millions of colonists out there who don't even know how close they came to dying.
If you do find Balak one day, remember my brother.
I wish I could've saved him, too.
Your brother was the one Balak killed?
Then I'd be no better than the batarians. Besides, Balak won't get away with this. I know who he is now. He can't run forever.
I don't plan to let Balak get away with this. I'll find him one day, and he'll pay for this.
I understand. You've been through enough today. I'll get out of your way.
Shepard. Commander Shepard.
Commander Shepard. With Special Tactics and Reconnaissance.
How did the asteroid get all the way over here? Why wasn't someone alerted sooner?
What can you tell me about the batarians? What were they hoping to achieve with all this?
You've been through a lot. I'll get out of your way. So long, Kate.
That was a brave thing you did, Kate. Contacting me on the radio, risking your life.
I'm sorry.
I should go.
Is that who died?
That's not my way.
I couldn't do that.
Perhaps.
Of course.
Asteroid
Batarians
You
Commander Shepard.
I'm a Spectre.
I appreciate that, Commander. Goodbye.
I'll get out of your way. So long, Kate.
I won't keep you.
I'll let you go.
Thank you so much. I thought we were all dead.
Those batarians are brutal.
I can't believe they were going to just send this asteroid into.... Can you imagine how many people would've died?
It's going to take some time, but we should be able to get this facility operational again.
Why now? What do the batarians want?
The people on Terra Nova should name a continent in your honor.
I saw my life flash before my eyes too many times in the last few hours.
At least the asteroid is still intact. We should be able to get this facility operational again soon enough.
You did it. Another hour and our course would have been irreversible.
I hope you get good use out of it.
I could really use some light armor.
The medium armor sounds like a good bet.
I need that heavy armor.
I know it's a lot to ask, but... that omni-tool of yours? I could really use something like that.
That omni-tool of yours looks handy. And expensive. Your gratitude go that far?
You have quarian armor? That's hard to come by.
Human Light Armor
Human Medium Armor
Human Heavy Armor
How about your omni-tool?
Hand over your omni-tool.
Quarian Armor
I ran the numbers, Shepard. X57 would have struck near the capital city. The most densely populated region.
But that's not going to happen, thanks to you.
Well. Thanks to you, I have a team to get things squared away here.
You might want to talk to Katie before you go. But, ah--
Before you go, I've got some equipment I'd like you to have.
I don't think I'll stick around, though. Not with the team gone. Too many ghosts.
It's time for me to get back and spend some time with my family.
But, before I go... I'd like to offer you something... maybe you'll have more use for it than I will.
As lead engineer, I get some quality items. Take your pick; you've earned it.
Shepard, I think I mentioned that you saved my kids and grandkids. What's an omni-tool compared to that? Take it, with my blessing.
How could I say no to the man who saved my home and family?
How could I say no to the woman who saved my home and family?
You can't imagine how much you've done. For all of us.
We'll get this place operational again.
I'm going to visit my family while we wait for the repair teams.
My home's safe. Just have to focus on that. Right?
I need to make sure everything's in order before I go.
Days like this make you realize just how important family is.
He left? Is that-- is that all right?
Is Katie in here? Is she all right? Is her team?
You let him go to save them?
Let a terrorist go, or sacrifice innocent lives. I-- I'm glad that's not a choice I had to make.
Is it safe?
Have you found Katie and her team?
You're-- you're not kidding, are you? Oh god.
All of them? Katie. And her brother? Everyone?
How could this happen? I thought you were-- Couldn't you save them?
In the future, run away from the sound of gunfire.
Forget it. Can you tell if the asteroid's stable?
I think so. There are hostages in one of the offices nearby. Balak said he'd blow them up if I didn't let him leave.
I let Balak walk so he wouldn't blow them up. If they're not all right, he's going to have a short, unhappy life.
Balak was holding them hostage. I let him go to save them.
Watch where you step. There were bombs, and there may be more. I need a sapper team to sweep the area.
Balak murdered Katie and the others. Blew them up with a bomb.
I'm sorry, Simon. Balak took Kate and some others as hostages. There was a bomb in their cell, and...
The batarians had a bomb. They were holding Katie and her team hostage. I'm afraid they detonated it.
That was the last of them. Can you tell if the asteroid's stable?
You should've stayed put.
That's not your problem.
I don't know.
She better be.
She's fine.
If you're careful.
It's safe.
They're dead.
You may want to sit down.
They were held hostage.
Anyone asks me? You did the right thing. They say otherwise, I'll set them straight.
That-- I-- I know in my head what you're saying makes sense. It's just a little hard to see the big picture right now. All right?
So this son of a bitch, this Balak.
At least he's dead. Right?
They're going to lock him up, right? Not in some cushy cell with extranet access. But someplace hard. Mean.
Yeah.
I can live with that.
You're letting him bleed to death?
No.
If anyone asks me, he was dead when I got here.
Good.
All right. I'm sorry. I can see that you're.... Well. I understand.
Shepard? Thank you. For my grandchildren's lives.
We hired a few to help install the torches. They really knew their stuff. You're welcome to take it.
There's a body in the office. Shot in the head. I'm pretty sure it's her brother, Aaron. Just... be kind to the girl. Please.
Right. I'll be careful.
I hope someone like you will be around to stop them.
I-- There might have been something I could have done to help. I thought I should be here. I know this asteroid better than anyone.
Is that-- will you get in trouble for that? I mean, he could do the same thing somewhere else. Couldn't he?
What? No, I--
Ease down, miss.
Ease down, son.
The Alliance has a whole navy full of people like me, waiting to take him down. We'll be watching.
Yes, I could have. If I let the batarians go. But then they might have done the same thing to another colony. Or two more. Or a dozen.
You need to understand something: not everyone out here in the big, bad galaxy likes humans. It's not safe.
Some days, the bad guys are going to win. You ask me, the good guys made out pretty well today.
The specifics are up to the courts.
Someplace where it hurts just to breathe.
That's the plan.
Would you prefer I let him live?
I think he deserves a slow death.
That's right.
There are people in the galaxy who'll kill a human whenever they're given a chance. Balak was one of them. I didn't give him the chance to run away and try again. The price was three lives.
Part of my job is to accept responsibility for decisions like that. I'll be glad to let Kate's face keep me awake tonight, if it means your family sleeps soundly.
Letting him go was better than the alternative. I thought you were going to stay someplace safe?
This facility is secure. But the batarians can always attack another colony.
You're standing in the open. You haven't been shot. What do you think?
Yeah, he could. Balak seemed like a practical man. Practical, but callous. I'm sure if he'd been in my place, Ms. Bowman would be dead now, along with all the terrorists.
But I'm not going to sacrifice people who happen to be between me and my target.
You think I should've let him blow up your friends? Sacrificed a few now to avoid possible deaths later?
Nobody dies on my watch. Yeah, Balak might attack another colony in the future. If he does, I'll be there to nail him to the wall.
The cost was too high.
No one could've done better.
I did my duty.
I hope they will.
As hard as possible.
Yes.
You object?
Damn right I am.
Yes.
It was the only option.
As safe as it gets.
If it wasn't, you'd be dead.
I'm not like him.
Should I have let them die?
He won't get the chance.
Say, Shepard? You didn't happen to find any of my engineers, did you?
Well. I wouldn't want you after me.
Well. When you put it that way. Yeah. I guess it'll be a long time before he can try doing this to anyone else.
Have you found them?
Oh. I-- I see. Well, then. I guess it's better than not knowing.
I-- I see. Well. Maybe the last is still out there. Could you please keep looking?
I-- I see. Well. Maybe the other two are still out there. Would you mind looking?
See if you can tap into our transmission tower out on the surface. Their equipment sheds will show up on your sensors.
Be well, Shepard. We owe you.
So what happens now? The bad guys get away?
Can't say as I have.
Yes. Balak gets away. But does that really matter? Terra Nova is safe. Kate and her crew are safe. You're safe.
Meantime, Balak's lost his followers, he's lost a lot of material, and he didn't accomplish anything. I think we won here, Simon.
One more thing. You asked me to look into your missing engineers.
Yes, all of them. Their bodies, anyway.
I found two of them. They didn't make it.
I came across a member of your crew. He didn't make it.
Not yet. Can you think of anything that would help me find them?
Take care of yourself.
Balak gets away today. But we'll still be after him tomorrow, and the day after that. Me, my crew, and every other crew in the Alliance.
He'll run, and he'll hide. But eventually he'll slip up, and we'll get him. Bad guys never get away, Simon. Not unless the good guys give up.
Have you ever hunted, Simon? Actually stalked an animal in the wilderness?
Hunting an animal requires patience and discipline. I'll wait for this batarian animal to pop his head up again. And then I'll come down on him like the wrath of God.
Only temporarily.
Oh, he won't get away.
Yes, but it doesn't matter.
About your three engineers.
Goodbye
They didn't make it.
Only two.
Just one so far.
No, I haven't
How could I track them?
How could I track them?
Release the varren!
Look out!
Take cover.
Fresh meat.
Harak. Chekt! Chekt!
Perimeter breached!
Arm the drones!
Send the drones in!
Humans! Take 'em out!
Balak wants them all dead!
Alliance military!
Die, human!
Filthy human scum!
Balak's down!
They got Charn!
D...d...d...die, human!
Fall back to base!
Go! Go! Go!
Move it!
Hold the line!
Death before surrender!
Attack!
